capabilities: Schedule recurring routines by weekday, day of month, or interval
Generate a daily checklist note with the day's tasks
View scheduled tasks on a monthly calendar
Track completion rates, perfect days, and per-routine streaks
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes journaling tool; its main job is habit tracking, and the daily note it creates is a task checklist.
extras: Data stays in plain Markdown notes readable without the plugin; localized in English and Korean.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule recurring tasks or track habit completion and streaks across days.

relations.evidence: they are appended to its task line in the daily note, so they work with tag queries, Dataview

summary: Habit tracker that generates a daily Markdown checklist note from recurring routines and one-time todos, with calendar and streak tracking.
